study type: Propensity score-matched cohort quality improvement study
exposure: surfactant with tracheal mechanical ventilation for less than one hour (InSurE)
outcome: Incidence of supplemental oxygen on day 28
Bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) at 36 weeks postmenstrual age
cohort: The study included 379 preterm infants born before 30 weeks gestational age.
finding: Less invasive surfactant administration (LISA) was associated with fewer tracheal ventilation days and a lower incidence of supplemental oxygen on day 28, but not with a lower risk of death or bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) at 36 weeks postmenstrual age.
